limitations: The vibration dataset is SYNTHETIC. No physical accelerometer, motor or machine was measured at any point.
ARM Cortex-M4 execution is QEMU emulation (machine mps2-an386). No physical microcontroller was programmed, run or timed.
Reported accuracy reflects the separability of the synthetic generator, not demonstrated model capability. Simpler baselines reach the same score.
No wall-clock inference latency or energy figure is included, because neither can be obtained from emulation without a calibrated cycle model.
